subject: mathematics
title: Grade 4 Mathematics
description: Fractions, decimals, area, perimeter, and factors

questions.question: Which is the correct decimal for three-tenths?
questions.explanation: Three-tenths = 3/10 = 0.3. The tenths place is one digit to the right of the decimal point.

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle 8 cm long and 5 cm wide?
What is the Roman numeral for 40?
questions.explanation: XL = 40 in Roman numerals. X (10) before L (50) means 50 - 10 = 40.

questions.question: A train travels 240 km in 4 hours. What is its speed?
What is 1/4 + 2/4?
questions.explanation: When denominators are the same, just add numerators: 1/4 + 2/4 = 3/4.

questions.question: Which of these numbers is a prime number?
questions.explanation: 23 is prime — it is only divisible by 1 and 23. 15=3×5, 21=3×7, 25=5×5.

questions.question: What is 5,000 + 700 + 30 + 8 written as a number?
questions.explanation: 5,000 + 700 + 30 + 8 = 5,738. Each digit occupies its place value position.

questions.question: How many grams are in 2 kilograms?
What is the LCM of 4 and 6?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 4: 4, 8, 12, 16... Multiples of 6: 6, 12, 18... The LCM (Least Common Multiple) is 12.

questions.question: An angle of 90 degrees is called a _____ angle.
questions.explanation: A right angle measures exactly 90°. It looks like the corner of a square.

questions.question: Which of these is a composite number?
questions.explanation: 18 is composite because it has factors other than 1 and itself: 18 = 2 × 9 = 3 × 6.
